extras.title: Type C U-bend kits also available
Part-number builder key
extras.text: Interpretation of the builder diagram (not catalog text): RP-T5C-G2 / RP-T8C-G2 (Type C T5 / T8 kit) and RP-LBE-G2 (linear barkit, external driver) are built as PREFIX-[WATTAGE]-[LENGTH]-[#LAMPS]-[8+COLOR]-[DIMMING]-[HV*]. WATTAGE: 12W, 25W, 45W or 80W (each selectable within the settings shown in parentheses). LENGTH: 2, 3 or 4 FT for Type C kits; 1 to 5 FT for LBE. #LAMPS: 1L to 4L. 8+COLOR: color code 30 (3000K), 35 (3500K), 40 (4000K) or 50 (5000K) following the '8' prefix of the pattern (interpretation: 8 = 80+ CRI). DIMMING: 10V standard (0-10V dim); LVD (120-277V TRIAC), 1 STEP (single switch) or 2 STEP (double switch) optional. HV: add -HV for 120-347V models.
